title: Replit
description: Replit's official brand guide publishes named hex values: Replit Orange (#ff3c00), Off White (#faf6f1), Light/Pale Orange (#ff764d, #ffb199), warm greys (#dbd4cf, #767270, #312e2e), Off Black (#181818), White (#ffffff), Light Gray/Silver tones (#ededed, #e2e2e2, #c5c5c5), and Black (#000000).
